title: fix: show Lyria 3.5 per-song pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Marks Lyria 3.5 as a flat-rate audio model.
- Shows 0.08 Pollen per generated song instead of an estimated 1.2 Pollen per second.
- Adds a catalog pricing regression test.

Tests: `npx vitest run test/pricing-data.test.ts` (56 passed)

Fixes #15549

gist.headline: A song has one price
gist.blurb: Lyria 3.5 now shows its price per song. Much easier to read than a per-second estimate for a song that hasn't been written yet.
gist.summary: Marked Lyria 3.5 as a flat-rate audio model so the catalog displays 0.08 Pollen per generated song instead of an estimated 1.2 Pollen per second, with a regression test to keep the display accurate.
gist.impact: Users can see Lyria 3.5's per-song price before generating music, rather than a per-second estimate.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Lyria 3.5 as a cozy music-making setup: a retro music player, a floating pixel song note, and a clear tag reading '0.08 Pollen / song'. Polli, wearing tiny headphones, points out the tag beside a small code-plant; no separate Lyria mascot is indicated.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art music nook, Polli points to a pixel-font tag reading '0.08 Pollen / song' beside a retro music player emitting gentle notes, with a code-plant growing nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny headphones; she is small-to-medium in the scene, strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
